environmentSecretsStayOnHost: Secrets stay on the daemon host
planManifestHelp: Review the daemon plan before approval.
planManifestDetailsFull: This is the daemon's immutable normalized configuration, manifest, paths, command and warnings—not a prediction from your draft. Read it before starting. Submission sends only this exact plan ID.
noPlanDifferences: The plan matches the training defaults.
leaveDoesNotCancel: Leaving this page does not cancel server work
fastPresetHelp: Shorter exploratory training, not a duration guarantee.
balancedPresetHelp: Moderate epoch budget and early stopping.
accuracyPresetHelp: More epochs and patience; improved accuracy is not guaranteed.
exportValidationRequired: Validate all training and execution fields before exporting.
yamlExportFailed: YAML export could not be requested. Check your browser download settings and retry.
clipboardUnavailable: Clipboard unavailable; select the displayed command manually.
planRetryHelp: If acknowledgment is lost, check or retry this same plan.
interpreterHelp: Absolute interpreter path on the execution host.
runtimeHelp: Device and topology are checked during planning.
runtimeDetails: Device, precision and topology are validated during daemon planning. Bundled/container modes and explicit MPS training are not implemented by current backends; planning refuses them. Slurm account, partition, resources, environment setup and storage mappings remain configured operator policy, not invented browser defaults.
environmentHelp: Environment values are included in the execution plan.
environmentDetails: These values are in the persisted execution plan. Do not enter credentials here; configure secrets on the daemon host.
environmentNameInvalid: Use a unique environment name; scheduler and launcher identity are daemon-owned.
customModelHelp: Enter a registered model ID; compatibility is not verified here.
customModelFailed: Custom identifier could not be selected. Verify the daemon connection and retry.
connectionRequired: Connect to the daemon before choosing files, planning or submitting.
resetHelp: Training fields reset; selections stay. Existing runs are unchanged.
submissionAckHelp: {run} · {state}. This acknowledgment is not proof of training completion; open the run monitor for current evidence.
submissionAckUnknown: The request was not acknowledged; server work may already exist. Reconnect if needed, then retry preview with this unchanged draft, or check/retry the approved submission. Never create a replacement draft merely to retry.
planRefused: The daemon refused this plan. Correct the settings and preview again.
selectionRequired: Choose a dataset and model from this daemon first.
selectionStale: Selection or configuration is stale. Select again from the verified daemon.
planValidationRequired: Review the validation errors before requesting a plan.
